tool.name: Zip files
tool.description: matching a name pattern or extension
tool.command:
mkdir zip_folder &&
#for $i, $f in enumerate($inputs) ln -s '$f' 'zip_folder/${f.element_identifier}.${f.ext}' && #end for
cd zip_folder &&
zip -$compression archive.zip $pattern && mv archive.zip '$output'

param.name: inputs
param.label: Input collection
param.help: Select the collection whose elements you want to zip

param.name: pattern
param.label: Files extension patterns
param.help: Glob pattern matched against file names, e.g. '*.txt', '*.pdf', 'sample_*'. Default '*' includes everything.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Collects the selected input files into a single ZIP archive, keeping only those whose file name matches the given pattern.
**Pattern**
A shell glob matched against the file names:
- ``*.txt`` — all files ending in .txt - ``sample_*`` — all files starting with sample - ``*`` — everything (default)
**Compression level**
Choose from store (0, no compression) up to maximum (9).
